description: A sine of amplitude 0.25 as 32-bit floats that are all whole multiples of 2^-23 and not all of 2^-15, with a run of 5 and one of 2 at 8388607/8388608 (one run), 3 at -1.0 and 4 at 32767/32768 (a 16-bit value, not an extreme of the 24-bit grid): the extremes are those of the 24-bit grid, so 2 runs.
